scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh...?
A Novice?
Still thinking
what job you're
gonna choose...
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
呃...？
一个初心者？
还在纠结要选什么职业...
我猜得没错吧？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Whaaaat are you
doin' here? There's
nothing I can teach you!
You're waaay beyond me!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你...你在这儿干嘛？
我没什么能教你的！
你完全超出我的能力范围了！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Heya pal.
I'm Yierhan.
I happen to be
the guy in charge
of training new Thieves.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嘿，朋友。
我是叶尔汗。
我正好是负责训练新盗贼的人。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, enough about stats.
You know what? I think I'll just talk to you about the skills that we Thieves use.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好了，属性什么的就不多说了。
你知道吗？我觉得还是聊聊我们盗贼使用的技能比较好。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Okay, let me see your skills. You know you gotta change your battle strategy depending on what skills you have, right? Skills are just as important as stats!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好，让我看看你的技能。你知道要根据拥有的技能来改变战斗策略，对吧？技能和属性一样重要！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So...
Are there any
skills you want
explained or is this
pretty much stuff you
already know?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
那么...
有没有什么你想了解的技能？还是说这些你都已经知道了？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, we studied the skills and you've been practicing a little, right? You better have...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好了，我们研究了技能，你也稍微练习了一下，对吧？你最好已经...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
'Ey, you don't have the 10 ^ff0000Feather of Birds^000000 I asked you for! You gotta apply what you know, you know.
Now hurry up and do it!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
喂，你没有我让你找的10个^ff0000鸟羽^000000！你得把学到的东西付诸实践啊。
快去快回！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright...!
Nice work, pal.
Seeing as you got these feathers, you must be really gung-ho about becoming a good Thief.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
很好...！
干得漂亮，朋友。
既然你能找到这些羽毛，看来你是真的想成为一名优秀的盗贼。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
[Yierhan]
You know...
There was this
fight that was in
the Southern part
of this town.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
[叶尔汗]
你知道吗...
之前在这个城镇的南部发生过一场战斗。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Heya pal.
You doin' alright?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嘿，朋友。
你还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I heard there was
this one Assassin
that went on a mission
and never returned.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
我听说有一个刺客去执行任务后就没有回来。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
'Ey, did you
complete your mission?
I know, I know, the thing you've gotta do is pretty rough.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
喂，你完成任务了吗？
我知道，我知道，你要做的事情确实很棘手。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
[Yierhan]
Hey...
You got dreams,
don't you? I know,
it's a bit of a deep
subject I pulled outta
nowhere, but...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
[叶尔汗]
嘿...
你有梦想，对吧？我知道，我这个问题有点突兀，但是...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
[Yierhan]
Heya.
I'm the Thief trainer around here. Sure, it looks like we don't got much in common, but...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
[叶尔汗]
嘿。
我是这里的盗贼训练师。虽然看起来我们没什么共同点，但是...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hm...?
That's weird, usually only
Thieves hang around this joint. What's someone like you doing
here? Unless...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嗯...？
真奇怪，通常只有盗贼会在这个地方徘徊。像你这样的人为什么会在这里？除非...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So how's the
investigation
coming along?
I've been so busy,
I couldn't focus
on it at all...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
那么...
调查进展如何？
我太忙了，完全没顾得上...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just as I thought,
more than one group
was involved in all this.
Huh. Something real bad
might happen soon...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
果然，牵涉到不止一个组织。
嗯。恐怕很快就会发生很糟糕的事情...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So...
Are there any
skills you want
explained or is this
pretty much stuff you
already know?
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
那么...
有没有什么你想了解的技能？还是说这些你都已经知道了？
有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、不舒服且没人想去的地方。但这里其实有很多很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、不舒服且没人想去的地方。但这里其实有很多很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Listen, if you ever decide to become a Thief--a smart choice
I might add--come and talk to me. I'll show you the ropes!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
听着，如果你决定成为一名盗贼——顺便说一句，这是个明智的选择——就来找我聊聊吧。我会教你入门的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
In fact, I think
you're qualified
to teach me some stuff!
Come on! I need new moves!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
事实上，我觉得你完全有资格教我一些东西！
来吧！我需要学些新招式！

scripts.text: Training?
scripts.translation: 训练？

scripts.text: Training? Right now?
scripts.translation: 训练？现在？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah, training. I mean, this kind of stuff is second nature to some people, but other guys need a little more help. So this is one of those 'just in case' things.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
没错，训练。我是说，对有些人来说，这些技能已经是本能了，但其他人可能需要多一点帮助。所以这是一种“以防万一”的准备。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Right now?
Yeah, right now!
But if you're not ready for some reason, I guess I can wait.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
现在？
没错，就是现在！
不过如果你因为某些原因还没准备好，我想我可以等等。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, first of all, Thieves use melee attacks. Well, most of us do. There are a few who like using long range Bows. But all of us are good at bein' fast!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好吧，首先，盗贼主要使用近战攻击。嗯，大多数人都这样。也有少数人喜欢使用远程的弓。但我们所有人都擅长快速移动！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So for melee attacks, which stat increases your damage? Come on
now, you should know this if you didn't skip the Novice Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
那么对于近战攻击，哪个属性能增加你的伤害？来吧，如果你没有跳过训练场，你应该知道这个。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Say whaaat? ^6B8E23INT^000000 affects magic damage, magic defense and some skills. Thieves don't even work with magic!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你说什么？^6B8E23INT^000000影响的是魔法伤害、魔法防御和一些技能。盗贼甚至不使用魔法！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You musta skipped the Novice Training Grounds altogether! Not that I blame you though. Anyway, it's ^2F4F2FSTR^000000 that increases your attack damage, got it?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你肯定是完全跳过了训练场！不过我不怪你。总之，是^2F4F2FSTR^000000增加你的攻击伤害，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So if you're feeling like the damage you're making is pretty weak, you might want more stat points in ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. How high your raise your own STR is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
所以如果你觉得你的伤害很弱，你可能需要在^2F4F2FSTR^000000上投入更多的属性点。你要把STR加到多高，完全由你自己决定。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah, that's right! If you wanna increase your damage, you need
to put some stat points into ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. Increasing STR also increases
your Max Weight Limit too.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
没错，就是这样！如果你想增加伤害，你需要把一些属性点加到^2F4F2FSTR^000000上。提高STR也会增加你的最大负重上限。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So if you're feeling like the damage you're making is pretty weak, you might want more stat points in ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. How high your raise your own STR is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
所以如果你觉得你的伤害很弱，你可能需要在^2F4F2FSTR^000000上投入更多的属性点。你要把STR加到多高，完全由你自己决定。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Sure, ^23238EDEX^000000 and LUK can
also increase your attack damage, but they're insignificant compared to STR. I repeat: ^660000insignificant^000000.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
当然，^23238EDEX^000000和LUK也能增加你的攻击伤害，但与STR相比，它们微不足道。我再说一遍：^660000微不足道^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Say whaaat? ^23238EDEX^000000 affects
your attack accuracy, not your damage! Well, unless you're using
a Bow. Otherwise, it increases your damage only by a tiny bit.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你说什么？^23238EDEX^000000影响的是你的攻击命中率，而不是伤害！除非你在使用弓。否则，它只会稍微增加一点点伤害。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You musta skipped the Novice Training Grounds altogether! Not that I blame you though. Anyway, it's ^2F4F2FSTR^000000 that increases your attack damage, got it?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你肯定是完全跳过了训练场！不过我不怪你。总之，是^2F4F2FSTR^000000增加你的攻击伤害，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So if you're feeling like the damage you're making is pretty weak, you might want more stat points in ^2F4F2FSTR^000000. How high your raise your own STR is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
所以如果你觉得你的伤害很弱，你可能需要在^2F4F2FSTR^000000上投入更多的属性点。你要把STR加到多高，完全由你自己决定。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
So level up your skills, learn a few new ones if you want, and
then come back over here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
所以去提升你的技能等级，如果想学几个新技能就学吧，然后回到这里来。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You haven't learned any skills yet? Come on, it's your skills that'll set you apart from Novices and everyone else!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你还没学任何技能？拜托，正是技能让你与初心者和其他人区分开来！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Ah, so you've learned
Level {0} Double Attack.
Nice! This skill gives you the chance to attack twice in one
attack. Wicked!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
啊，所以你学会了等级{0}的二刀连击。
不错！这个技能让你有机会在一次攻击中攻击两次。太酷了！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
It's a Passive skill, so it's always in effect and won't have to use any SP to use it. The higher your Double Attack skill level, the more double attacks you'll do.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
这是被动技能，所以它始终生效，使用时不需要消耗SP。你的二刀连击等级越高，触发连击的次数就越多。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Let's see...
Level {0} Increase Dodge?
That increases your Flee Rate, meaning you've got a better chance of dodging attacks from your enemies.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
让我看看...
等级{0}的残影？
这会增加你的闪避率，意味着你有更好的机会躲避敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just like the Double Attack skill, Increase Dodge is a Passive skill. It won't use SP and it's always in
effect. If you don't like to bruise, this is your skill.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
就像二刀连击一样，残影也是被动技能。它不消耗SP，且始终生效。如果你不想挨打，这就是你的技能。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Whoa, so you've
got Level {0} Steal~
Now that's the skill which gives our job its name! You can't use
it against people, though...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
哇，你居然有等级{0}的偷窃~
这可是让我们这个职业得名的技能！不过，你不能对人使用它...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
But you can use Steal to take items from monsters. If you're lucky, you can get some good items that way. Oh, and Steal doesn't affect monster drop rates.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
但你可以用偷窃从魔物身上夺取物品。如果你运气好，就能获得一些不错的物品。哦，对了，偷窃不会影响魔物的掉落率。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You've learned
Level {0} Hiding?
Let's see, you can only learn
that after learning the Steal skill up to a certain level.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你学会了等级{0}的隐匿？
让我看看，你只有在将偷窃技能学到一定等级后，才能学习这个技能。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Of course, you use 
the Hiding skill to hide underground in an emergency, like when you're surrounded by tough enemies. Be careful though...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
当然，当你被强大的敌人包围等紧急情况下，你可以使用隐匿技能躲到地下。不过要小心...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Certain monsters will still be able to find you, no matter how well you hide. There are even a few monsters that can flush you out of hiding!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
某些魔物无论你怎么躲藏都能找到你。甚至有一些魔物能把你从隐匿状态中揪出来！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, I see that you
know Level {0} Envenom.
You like being dangerous,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好吧，我看到你知道等级{0}的施毒。
你喜欢危险，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
This attack skill has the chance
to poison your enemy for a set amount of time. While poisoned, an enemy will constantly lose its HP and will have decreased defense.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
这个攻击技能有机会使敌人在一定时间内中毒。中毒的敌人会持续损失HP，并且防御力下降。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh, but remember.
If the monster's too strong for you, you might not be able to poison it. So don't go crazy.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
呃，但请记住。
如果魔物比你强太多，你可能无法让它中毒。所以别太冲动。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Level {0} Detoxify.
If you took the trouble to learn that, you must be the cautious
type or something.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
等级{0}的解毒。
如果你费心学了这个，那你一定是个谨慎的人，或者什么的。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You can only learn Detoxify
after you learn the Envenom skill. Detoxify allows you to counteract the effects of poison on a target.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你只有在学会施毒技能后，才能学习解毒。解毒可以消除目标身上的中毒效果。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, I guess
if you want to know
about any other skills,
I can explain real quick.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好吧，我想如果你想知道其他任何技能，我可以快速解释一下。

scripts.text: Double Attack
scripts.translation: 二刀连击

scripts.text: Increase Dodge
scripts.translation: 残影

scripts.text: Steal
scripts.translation: 偷窃

scripts.text: Hiding
scripts.translation: 隐匿

scripts.text: Envenom
scripts.translation: 施毒

scripts.text: Detoxify
scripts.translation: 解毒

scripts.text: I know enough.
scripts.translation: 我了解得够多了

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just like its name,
Double Attack gives your attacks the chance to be a double attack, two strikes in one blow.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
顾名思义，二刀连击让你的攻击有机会变成连击，即一次攻击造成两次打击。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
It's a Passive skill, so it's always in effect and won't have to use any SP to use it. The higher your Double Attack skill level, the more double attacks you'll do.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
这是被动技能，所以它始终处于生效状态，且不需要消耗SP。你的二刀连击技能等级越高，触发连击的次数就越多。
有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、令人不适且没人想去的地方。
但这里其实有各种各样很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Increase Dodge
gives a nice boost
to your Flee Rate that
the other jobs don't offer.
Why take your lumps when you
can avoid them altogether?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
残影能极大地提高你的闪避率，这是其他职业所不具备的优势。
既然可以完全避开攻击，何必硬挨呢？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Just like the Double Attack skill, Increase Dodge is a Passive skill. It won't use SP and it's always in
effect. If you don't like to bruise, this is your skill.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
和二刀连击一样，残影也是被动技能。它不消耗SP，且始终处于生效状态。如果你不想挨打，这就是你的技能。
有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、令人不适且没人想去的地方。
但这里其实有各种各样很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Steal is an Active Skill that has the chance of nabbing you some
free items! You can't use it against other people, though.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
偷窃是一个主动技能，有机会让你白捡一些物品！不过，你不能对其他人使用它。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
But you can use Steal to take items from monsters! If you're lucky, you can get some good items that way. Oh, and Steal doesn't affect monster drop rates.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
但你确实可以用偷窃从魔物身上获取物品！如果你运气好，就能得到不错的物品。哦，对了，偷窃不会影响魔物的掉落率。
有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、令人不适且没人想去的地方。
但这里其实有各种各样很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hiding is an active skill where you submerge yourself underground. You can only stay hidden so long, and you can't move, but sometimes it's better than being found!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
隐匿是一个主动技能，让你潜入地下。你只能隐藏一段时间，且无法移动，但有时候这比被发现要好得多！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Of course, you use 
the Hiding skill to hide underground in an emergency, like when you're surrounded by tough enemies. Be careful though...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
当然，当你被强大的敌人包围等紧急情况下，你可以使用隐匿技能躲到地下。不过要小心...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Certain monsters will still be able to find you, no matter how well you hide. There are even a few monsters that can flush you out of hiding!
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
某些魔物无论你怎么隐藏都能找到你。甚至有一些魔物能把你从隐匿状态中揪出来！
有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、令人不适且没人想去的地方。
但这里其实有各种各样很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Envenom is an offensive Active Skill that every Thief should know. But that's just what I think.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
施毒是一个进攻性的主动技能，每个盗贼都应该掌握。但这只是我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
This attack skill has the chance
to poison your enemy for a set amount of time. While poisoned, an enemy will constantly lose its HP and will have decreased defense.
Remember that.
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
这个攻击技能有机会使敌人在一定时间内中毒。中毒状态下，敌人会持续损失HP，且防御力下降。
记住这一点。
有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、令人不适且没人想去的地方。
但这里其实有各种各样很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Since Thieves deal
quite a bit with poison,
we've got to have a way
to, well, have a taste
of our own medicine.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
既然盗贼经常与毒药打交道，我们就必须掌握一种方法，来，嗯，应付自己的毒。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You can learn Detoxify
after you learn the Envenom skill. Detoxify allows you to counteract the effects of poison on a target.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
学会施毒技能后，你可以学习解毒。解毒可以消除目标身上的中毒效果。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah...
I'm tired of explaining these skills anyway. Let's move on to
the next part of Thief training...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嗯...
反正我也讲累了。让我们进入盗贼训练的下一部分吧...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Now that you're such an expert on skills, I want you to level up your skills and come back, got it?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
既然你现在对技能这么精通，我希望你提升技能等级后再回来，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright, now I got some actual fight training I want you to do. Here's a chance for you to figure what skills are best for which situations.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好了，现在我要给你一些实战训练。这是一个机会，让你弄清楚在什么情况下使用什么技能最合适。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Go and get me
10 ^ff0000Feather of Birds^000000.
You can go ahead and kill Pickies to get those. It really shouldn't be that hard. Oh, and use this Wing thingee to come back.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
去给我弄10个^ff0000鸟羽^000000。
你可以去杀小鸡来获取它们。这真的不应该太难。哦，还有，用这个翅膀玩意儿回来。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I hope you keep
putting in the work
to get better and better.
Always do your best! Oh,
and do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
我希望你能继续努力，变得越来越强。
永远做到最好！哦，你还有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: About those traces...
scripts.translation: 关于那些痕迹...

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You found out, eh?
Well, I didn't really
wanna tell you this, on
account of you bein' a brand
brand new Thief and all, but...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你发现了，是吗？
嗯，我本来真不想告诉你这些，毕竟你是个彻头彻尾的新手盗贼，但是...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
There was this
fight that was in
the Southern part
of this town.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
在城镇的南部发生过一场打斗。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Since it happened late at night, only a few people actually know about it. As for me, I stayed late at a guild meeting, so it was
dumb luck that I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
因为发生在深夜，实际上知道这件事的人很少。至于我，因为参加公会会议留到了很晚，所以看到这一幕纯属巧合。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I went back to where the fight happened and I found traces that showed that the guys who were fighting went south.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
我回到打斗发生的地方查看了一下，发现了一些痕迹，显示打斗的人往南边去了。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Since poison was used in
the fight, I'm guessing an Assassin was involved, but I can't be too sure. If you wanna check it out, follow the traces of that fight.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
既然打斗中用到了毒药，我猜测有刺客参与，但我不能百分百确定。如果你想查清楚，就顺着那些打斗的痕迹去找吧。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh, but be careful
not to get too close
to the poison! That stuff
is pretty strong!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
呃，不过要小心别靠毒药太近！那玩意儿毒性挺强的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Good!
Less work for me!
Alright, you better get stronger the next time I see you. Oh, and you can have this stuff. You know, since you're so gangster and all.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好！
省了我不少事！
好了，下次见到你时，你最好变强一点。哦，还有，这些给你。你知道的，谁让你这么有派头呢。

scripts.text: It was nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 很高兴认识你

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah, it was pretty cool just hanging out. Keep fighting
monsters the way you do and
you'll be a great Thief in no time.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
是啊，一起闲逛挺不错的。继续像现在这样打怪，你很快就能成为出色的盗贼了。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
And since I like
you so much, kid,
you can have this.
Take it, it's yours!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
而且，既然我这么喜欢你，小家伙，这个给你吧。
拿着，这是你的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Good!
Less work for me!
Alright, you better get stronger the next time I see you. Oh, and you can have this stuff. You know, since you're so gangster and all.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好！
省了我不少事！
好了，下次见到你时，你最好变强一点。哦，还有，这些给你。你知道的，谁让你这么有派头呢。

dumb luck that I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
因为发生在深夜，实际上知道这件事的人很少。至于我，因为参加公会会议留到了很晚，所以看到这一幕纯属巧合。

I went back to where the fight happened and I found traces that showed that the guys who were fighting went south.
scripts.translation:

the fight, I'm guessing an Assassin was involved, but I can't be too sure. If you wanna check it out, follow the traces of that fight.

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Eh, but be careful
not to get too close
to the poison! That stuff
is pretty strong!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
呃，不过要小心别靠毒药太近！那玩意儿毒性挺强的！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, you might run into
poison, so remember that
Green Herbs and Green Potions
will counteract it. Oh, and keep in mind that Red Gemstones can
be used in poison attacks.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嘿，你可能会遇到毒药，所以记住绿色药草和绿色药水可以解毒。哦，还有，别忘了红色魔力矿石可以用于毒攻击。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, if you do
decide to check it
out, be real careful
other there, okay?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嘿，如果你决定去查的话，一定要非常小心，那里很危险，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Fighting against something
you know nothing about is always risky. Since I've heard there are outsiders around flaunting their power, you better be careful.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
与完全不了解的东西对抗总是很危险的。既然我听说有外人在那里炫耀武力，你最好小心点。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
It's a good policy to just be really careful on your adventures. Look out for monsters and look
out for people! Got it?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
在冒险中保持极度谨慎是个好策略。小心魔物，也要小心人！明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
What's so weird about it was that the Assassin Guild reported that the mission was completed!
I remember hearing that guy
was really good...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
奇怪的是，刺客公会报告说任务已经完成了！
我记得听说那个人真的很厉害...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Crazy, isn't it?
Anyway, take
care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
真疯狂，不是吗？
总之，照顾好自己。

scripts.text: I'm still investigating.
scripts.translation: 我还在调查中

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没有

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，完成了

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Ah, gotcha. Well, that's understandable. I mean, these things take time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
啊，明白了。嗯，这很正常。毕竟，这些事情需要时间，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah...?
That's alright.
I guess these kinds of things require patience. And thinking.
You know, things I'm horrible at.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
是吗...？
没关系。
我想这类事情需要耐心。还有思考。
你知道的，我在这方面很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright...!
So what's up?
Hit me up with
what you know~
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好了...！
那么，有什么事吗？
把你所知道的告诉我吧~

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou explain the results of your investigation to Yierhan and tell him about the scrap of cloth you found on your mission.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向叶尔汗解释调查的结果，并告诉他你在任务中发现的那块布片。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Scrap of cloth?
Huh, alright. Say,
lemme have a looksee.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
布片？
嗯，好吧。喂，让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Whoa!
You did great.
This is some pretty
important information!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
哇！
你做得很棒。
这是相当重要的信息！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
You see, the pattern on this cloth is sort of like one of the codes Assassins use. And this particular pattern looks like something from one of those higher Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
你看，这块布上的图案有点像刺客使用的某种暗号。而这个特定的图案，看起来像是来自某位高阶刺客的。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I might be able to figure out what happened that night with the new information this cloth might lead me to. Thanks a lot!
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
有了这块布可能带来的新线索，我或许能弄清楚那天晚上发生了什么。太感谢了！

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
From here on,
the higher ups in the
guild will take over this investigation. You did your job perfectly, so it's time for you to hone your skills.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
从这里开始，公会的高层将接手这项调查。你做得非常完美，是时候去磨练你的技能了。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, this stuff is yours. Think of it as a reward for helping us out. Take care of yourself now~
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嘿，这些是你的。就当是感谢你的帮忙吧。照顾好自己哦~

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I just like telling people to follow their dreams. So do it. Life without anything to look forward to is pretty boring, doncha think?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
我只是喜欢鼓励人们去追逐梦想。所以去做吧。没有期待的生活是很无聊的，你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
I actually got a few magic using friends here and there. That mystic stuff is waaay over my head, but
I got a lotta respect for it.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
我其实有几个会使用魔法的朋友。那些神秘的东西完全超出我的理解范围，但我对它们充满敬意。

scripts.text: I'm here on behalf of 'Mana.'
scripts.translation: 我是代表“玛娜”来的

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Right, you must be the help that Mana sent! You came just at the right time. You see, we found something weird in South Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
没错，你就是玛娜派来的帮手吧！你来得正是时候。你看，我们在南梦罗克发现了一些奇怪的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Basically, we found traces of poison that were used in a fight. We were going to investigate it, but we've been swamped with all this other work.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
基本上，我们发现了战斗中使用过的毒药痕迹。我们本来打算调查的，但最近被其他工作忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
That's why we've been asking
for help from the Mage Guild. Fortunately, I'm pals with Mana, so...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
所以我们一直在向魔法师公会寻求帮助。幸运的是，我和玛娜很熟，所以...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Anyway, head over to
South Morocc since it seems to be a good place to start investigating. You'll see what we found right outside the South Morocc gate.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
总之，去南梦罗克吧，那里似乎是开始调查的好地方。你会在南梦罗克大门外看到我们发现的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
What's so weird about it was that the Assassin Guild reported that the mission was completed!
I remember hearing that guy
was really good...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
奇怪的是，刺客公会报告说任务已经完成了！
我记得听说那个人真的很厉害...

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Be careful, pal.
It seems your
investigation
might be related to
that mysterious Assassin...
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
小心点，伙计。
你的调查似乎与那位神秘的刺客有关...

scripts.text: I'm still investigating.
scripts.translation: 我还在调查中

scripts.text: I'm not done yet...
scripts.translation: 我还没做完...

scripts.text: Oh, I finished~
scripts.translation: 哦，我做完了~

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Ah, gotcha. Well, that's understandable. I mean, these things take time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
啊，明白了。嗯，这很正常。毕竟，这些事情需要时间，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Yeah...?
That's alright.
I guess these kinds of things require patience. And thinking.
You know, things I'm horrible at.
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
是吗...？
没关系。
我想这类事情需要耐心。还有思考。
你知道的，我在这方面很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Alright...!
So what's up?
Hit me up with
what you know~
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
好了...！
那么，有什么事吗？
把你所知道的告诉我吧~

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
Hey, this stuff is yours. Think of it as a reward for helping us out. Right, and I'll let Mana know you did a great job. Take care of yourself now~
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
嘿，这些是你的。就当是感谢你的帮忙吧。好了，我会告诉玛娜你做得很好。照顾好自己哦~

scripts.text:
Some people think
the desert is just a
dangerous, uncomfortable
place where no one wants
to be. But there's all
sorts of great stuff here.
scripts.translation: 有些人觉得沙漠只是一个危险、令人不适的地方，没人想去那里。但其实这里有很多很棒的东西。

scripts.text:
[Yierhan]
We got the blazing heat that encourages skimpy outfits, we got... Cacti. We got more sand than the beach. Um... Sandstorms?
scripts.translation:
[叶尔汗]
我们有鼓励穿清凉衣服的烈日，我们有...仙人掌。我们有比海滩更多的沙子。嗯...还有沙尘暴？
